First, find the time to run half a mile at 3 mph:  
Time = distance / speed = 0.5 miles / 3 mph = 1/6 hour.  
Convert to minutes: (1/6) × 60 = 10 minutes.

Next, find the time to walk half a mile at 1 mph:  
Time = 0.5 miles / 1 mph = 0.5 hour.  
Convert to minutes: 0.5 × 60 = 30 minutes.

Total time = 10 + 30 = 40 minutes.

Final answer: 40
